_comment: Apps of the same kind that someone looking for one of them would also want to be shown: looking for Chrome, a person may well prefer Chromium, Brave or Ungoogled Chromium, and no source says these belong together. A search that names one member lists the others straight after it. Keep it short: groups nearly everyone would agree on, members that are widely used. A member with only a name is taken from essentials.json (its summary and ids); any other has its own summary and the ids it goes by at each source, best first. 'words' are other things a person types for it. Every id given here was checked to exist at its source on 2026-11-27.
